content.title: Protector-Led Passage | Relationship Proof to a Shared Threshold
content.summary: First use close-range actions to establish the relationship between the protector and the person who needs to be escorted, and then ask the protector to turn around to confirm the route, continue to maintain visible contact, and pass through the familiar space; in the later stage, only a visually clear threshold is crossed to maintain evidence that the two people entered together.

quick_start.input_format: Protector and escorted + Relationship baseline + Route confirmation + Continuous guidance and contact + Crossing a single threshold together
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original mechanical archive, the brass librarian automaton protects the little paper bird with an articulated arm and ties a blue guide tape between the two; the two pass through two folding archive racks, the blue tape continues to stretch, and the automaton is always between the bird and the mobile bookshelf; the automaton first crosses over and guides the bird in in the same movement, and finally the two are framed together in the warm-colored library, and the blue tape and contact remain unchanged
required_anchors: Establish the protector and dependent role through visible contact before travel.
Show the protector choose or confirm one route before escorting.
Keep both identities and recurring landmarks traceable.
Cross one distinct threshold together and hold connection.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: First use close-range actions to establish the relationship between the protector and the person who needs to be escorted, and then ask the protector to turn around to confirm the route, continue to maintain visible contact, and pass through the familiar space; in the later stage, only a visually clear threshold is crossed to maintain evidence that the two people entered together.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish a protector-dependent relationship before movement, show the protector choose and lead one continuous route while maintaining readable contact, preserve both identities through the environment, then cross one visually distinct threshold together and hold their connection.

invariants.rule: Establish the protector and dependent role through visible contact before travel.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting in motion obscures the relationship.

invariants.rule: Show the protector choose or confirm one route before escorting.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unexplained cut to travel removes agency.

invariants.rule: Maintain readable physical or spatial guidance through the route.
Keep both identities and recurring landmarks traceable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Losing one subject breaks the route.

invariants.rule: Cross one distinct threshold together and hold connection.
invariants.ablation_failure: Separate crossings or a premature cut leave the outcome unclear.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source embrace and escort choreography
